thread:
Isha Kumar: Heads-up — noticed quota attribution is wrong for requests that go through api-proxy. Console shows the gateway as the origin instead of the customer project. Repro: call via third-party proxy using exchange token and we lose the project claim somewhere. :thinking:
Sam B.: ugh. is this the same thing where the 'origin-project' header gets stripped by the proxy? or are we losing the claim earlier during token exchange?
Marco Li: From a quick trace it looks like the proxy exchanges creds -> issues a new internal token and then forwards without preserving the original project claim. So billing/quotas see the proxy service account as caller.
Julia Chen: That's consistent with what the telemetry shows — a spike in "unattributed" meter for that tenant when they started using the proxy. We also lack a good dashboard to filter "exchange path" vs "direct call".
Isha Kumar: Proposal: add a short-lived signed header that the proxy can forward (X-ORIGIN-PROJECT + X-ORIGIN-SIG). Auth gateway verifies the sig and uses the header to attribute quota/telemetry. Stopgap: fallback to claims if header missing. Example:```python
# proxy side (pseudo)
req.headers['X-ORIGIN-PROJECT'] = origin_project
req.headers['X-ORIGIN-SIG'] = sign(origin_project, proxy_key)
# gateway verifies signature before trusting header
```
Sam B.: I like the signed-header approach — avoids trusting arbitrary headers. Couple of questions: 1) who signs? proxy service account or an intermediate exchange service? 2) rollout/console UX — we need a flag to allow teams to opt-in during canary.
Marco Li: signing key should be per-proxy-instance keypair or per-service account, rotated via KMS. Gateway already has trust anchors for some partners; we can add a new trust store for proxy keys. For rollout we add a per-route toggle in the console: "accept-origin-header (canary)" and surface telemetry when enabled.
Julia Chen: For dashboards, let's add a new panel: "Attribution path" (direct | proxied-signed | proxied-unsigned | unknown) and a sampling trace to attach a request_id to follow the exchange path. Also emit metric tags: origin_project_id, attribution_method.
Isha Kumar: Implement plan: 1) quick patch to proxy to emit header + sig (can be feature-flagged in proxy). 2) gateway change: verify sig and prefer header for attribution when valid; fallback to previous behaviour. 3) console: per-route canary toggle + new attribution panel (telemetry team owns panel). 4) rollout: start with 10% of proxy traffic for a week, compare billing attribution.
Sam B.: can we avoid schema churn on logs? prefer to reuse existing tags (origin_project_id) and add tag attribution_method for clarity. Also add a short-lived log field 'origin_verified' to prevent downstream confusion.
Marco Li: agree. I'll add support in auth-proxy repo. Patch will include verification code snippet:```go
if verifySig(req.Header.Get("X-ORIGIN-PROJECT"), req.Header.Get("X-ORIGIN-SIG")) {
  attrib = req.Header.Get("X-ORIGIN-PROJECT")
  method = "proxied-signed"
} else {
  attrib = extractFromTokenClaims(token)
  method = "token-claim"
}
emitMetric("request.attribution", map[string]string{"origin_project": attrib, "method": method})
```
Julia Chen: Telemetry keepers: we'll add a dashboard card and a short alert if "proxied-unsigned" > 5% of proxied traffic during canary (indicates misconfigured proxies). Also we'll sample full traces for those failures.
Isha Kumar: Security note — gateway must reject header if signature valid but proxy is not in allowlist for that project. Also log an audit event when we accept header attribution.
Sam B.: UX note — console toggle should show "Canary: Attribution header accepted" and a link to audit logs and a rollout button (10/50/100%). We need a PM blurb so customers know what to expect.
Julia Chen: I'll make the dashboard PR (panel + alert + sampling). Telemetry: add metric label 'attribution_method' and update ingestion schema.
Marco Li: I'll open the auth-proxy PR today behind a feature flag and add unit tests for sig verification + rotation docs.
deploy-bot: deploy queued — auth-proxy/feature/origin-header -> staging (sha: abc123) :rocket:
Isha Kumar: sweet. action items summarized: Marco -> auth-proxy PR w/ feature flag; Julia -> dashboard + alert; Sam -> console toggle mock & PM blurb; Isha -> gateway change + audit event. We'll check back after staging tests and 10% canary. :thumbsup:
